home.badge: Minecraft/Xbox access approved — the launcher is online
home.subtitle: Publish your server, link your CurseForge-verified modpack, and let your players join in one click with the Omniscient launcher.
home.featureDirectoryBody: Every server has its own page: description, modpack, live player status.
home.featureMsBody: Players sign in with their real Minecraft account, right inside the launcher.
home.featureModpackBody: Link your verified modpack so players join with no manual setup.

download.title: Get the
download.subtitle: Sign in with your Microsoft/Xbox account, browse servers, and join a modpack in one click. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
download.macRequirement: macOS 12 and later, Apple Silicon & Intel.
download.checksumsBody: Need a specific build or want to verify your download?

auth.heroTitle: Publish once. Play everywhere it matters.
auth.heroBody: Owners publish their modpacks and vanilla worlds; players discover and launch them straight from the launcher.
auth.signInHelp: Your Omniscient account is your Microsoft/Xbox account — the same one as in the launcher. Nothing separate to create.
auth.signInErrorProfile: Your Microsoft sign-in worked, but we couldn't fetch your Minecraft profile. Try again; if it keeps happening, it's on our side.
auth.signInErrorPending: Your Microsoft sign-in worked, but access to the Minecraft API is still pending Microsoft's approval. Try again later.

dashboard.empty: You don't have a server yet. Create your first listing to appear in the directory.
dashboard.newsEmpty: No news for now — site announcements will show up here.

servers.title: Server directory
servers.emptyNoQuery: No server yet — be the first to publish one.
servers.joinTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts — try again in a minute.

serverDetail.joinNote: To join this server, open it from the Omniscient launcher — the connection address isn't shown here.

friends.title: Friends
friends.addFeedback: If this player uses Omniscient, they'll get your request.
friends.empty: No friends yet. Send a request with a Minecraft username: your friend will need to accept it.
friends.incomingHint: wants to add you as a friend

manage.confirmToggleOff: Pause this server? It will disappear from the public directory, its page and the launcher until you republish it.
manage.confirmDuplicate: Duplicate this server? A copy will be created with its own listing.
manage.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this server? This action cannot be undone.
manage.actionFailed: Something went wrong — try again in a moment.
manage.activityNote: Player count isn't tracked over time yet — only the latest known value is shown above. A history would need a periodic background ping, which doesn't exist yet for this project.
manage.frozenHint: This server is frozen: the owner cannot put it back online.
manage.pendingVerificationHint: An admin needs to approve this server before it's visible and joinable by players.
manage.appealRequestConfirm: Confirm the request? An admin must decide within 72h, otherwise the server will be unfrozen automatically.
manage.appealPendingSecondOpinion: Second opinion requested — another admin must decide by {date}.
manage.appealPendingReflection: Reconsideration period requested — the freeze will be reviewed by {date} (only one active admin for now, no second opinion possible).

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Technical problems your players reported from the launcher.
reports.selectPrompt: Select a report from the list.
reports.versionMismatchHint: Your listing says {listed} but the server runs {actual} according to this report. Update the version in Settings to fix it for everyone.

serverForm.name: Server name
serverForm.descriptionPlaceholder: What makes this world worth joining?
serverForm.visibilityPublicHelp: Listed in the directory, search and the launcher. Anyone can join.
serverForm.visibilityPrivateHelp: Hidden everywhere. Only players with the invite link or code can join.
serverForm.visibilityPublicLocked: To publish your server, you must first test it in the launcher.
serverForm.inviteLinkResetConfirm: Reset the invite link? The old link will stop working immediately.
serverForm.inviteLinkHelp: Code {code} · players can also enter it in the launcher. Resetting invalidates the old link.
serverForm.inviteLinkPending: The link will be generated when you save.
serverForm.versionHelp: Not in the list? Choose "Other" to type it yourself.
serverForm.ipHelp: Never shown publicly on the site — only passed to the launcher.
serverForm.ramHelp: Suggested to the player in the launcher before joining (max 32GB, the launcher's limit) — never enforced, and the launcher warns if it exceeds what their machine can reasonably provide.
serverForm.autoConnectHelp: The game connects straight to the server on launch, skipping the Multiplayer menu. The address is always added to the player's Multiplayer list either way, whether this is enabled or not.
serverForm.autoConnectVersionWarning: Auto-connect is only available on Minecraft 1.20 and later — it has no effect on the version set here.
serverForm.modpackNote: Players download this modpack automatically on first launch, and always stay on its latest version — no manual setup.

imageUpload.failed: Couldn't upload the image — check the format and size shown above.

wizard.basicsSubtitle: This shows on your public listing and in the launcher.
wizard.visibilityPrivateOnlyNote: Your server is created private. To make it public, test it from the launcher ("Test for publishing" in My instances) — a successful test sends the request for review right away.
wizard.connectionSubtitle: The address is never shown publicly — only the launcher receives it.
wizard.connectionVerificationNote: Your server will be reviewed before publishing: make sure its address is reachable at the time you submit (or next edit) so the automated check can confirm its authenticity.
wizard.reviewSubtitle: You can change everything later from the management console.
wizard.modpackModrinthHint: Modrinth: every mod in a modpack can be downloaded automatically.
wizard.modpackCurseforgeHint: CurseForge: mods whose author forbids automatic download will have to be installed by hand.
wizard.modpackSourceDisabled: {source} is temporarily disabled by the team — search won't work. Pick another source or enter the ID by hand.
wizard.modpackNoResults: No modpack found for this search.
wizard.modpackChannelBetaHint: Also shows beta versions of the modpack, in addition to stable versions.
wizard.modpackNoBetaFound: No beta version found for this search.
wizard.modpackSearchUnavailable: {source} search is unavailable right now — enter the modpack details manually.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: A question, a problem, a suggestion? Write to us, we'll reply by email if needed.
contact.success: Message sent — thanks, we'll reply if needed.
contact.subtitleLong: A question, an issue with the Launcher or the Site, a complaint, a request about your personal data or a report: we read everything.
contact.responseBody: We usually reply within 3 business days, in French or English, to the email address you give.
contact.subjectHelp: Help with the Launcher or the Site
contact.consent: I agree that this information is used to answer my request.
contact.privacyNotice: Your information is only used to answer your request. You can ask to access, correct or delete it at any time (see the privacy policy).
contact.topicHelp: Help with the Launcher or the Site: tell us your system, the Launcher version (in the settings), what you were doing and the message shown.
contact.topicServer: Problem with a game server: first use the Launcher's "Report" button, it notifies the server owner directly. We do not run the listed servers.
contact.illicitIntro: To report a server page, image or text you believe is illegal, pick this subject and include:
contact.illicitUrl: the exact address (URL) of the content;
contact.illicitReasons: why you believe it is illegal;
contact.illicitGoodFaith: a statement that this information is accurate and complete, in good faith.
contact.illicitOutro: We acknowledge receipt, review the report carefully and let you know our decision.
